title: CPRA Request - El Cajon Police Department ALPR Data Sharing with Elk Grove Police Department

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Unless otherwise noted, the time period is January 1, 2023 to the date at which this request is fulfilled.

As of November 4th, 2026 El Cajon Police Department is no longer listed on the Elk Grove Police Department  ALPR website as an agency EGPD shares with:
https://elkgrove.gov/traffic/automated-license-plate-readers-alpr

Previously, it was listed as an agency that EGPD shares with. 

If sharing has ceased, provide any and all documentation of the termination of this sharing, including but not limited to;
- emails
- memoranda
- phone notes
- meeting notes
- written revocation of data sharing agreements
- any record of the suspension, termination, revocation, restriction, or change of El Cajon PD's access, whether El Cajon PD, Elk Grove PD, or Flock initiated it
- Flock configuration or administrative logs showing any addition, removal or change of El Cajon PD's access to Elk Grove PD system. If access is still active, records showing the current status.
- Communication between Elk Grove PD and Flock safety that mention; "El Cajon", The Attorney General's Lawsuit against the City of El Cajon, "SB 34", or communication relating to limits on El Cajon's sharing permissions with Elk Grove PD.
- Communications between El Cajon PD or The City of El Cajon and Elk Grove PD about ALPR access or sharing
- Any audit or review, including the 90 day audits, that mention El Cajon PD's access
- Records showing when and by whom El Cajon was removed from the published list, including CMS revision history, and related communications.

Please provide the records electronically and cite the specific exemption for anything withheld.

As a courtesy, I'd appreciate an answer on whether the removal reflects an error or an actual change in sharing agreements.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Yevgeniy Beregovyy

title: CPRA Request - Communications between the City of Elk Grove and Flock Safety

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request the records below for January 1st, 2026 through November 4th, 2026:
- All communications between Flock and the City of Elk Grove, especially those containing any of the following keywords in the subject or body of the communication or message; "Flock", "Flock Safety", "ALPR", "automated license plate reader", "LPR", "license plate camera", "Flock Invoice".
- All documents exchanged between Flock and the City of Elk Grove, including; attachments, presentations, quotes, order forms, redlines, drafts, final contracts and invoices, including those related to the contract amendment on April 8, 2026.
- Calendar entries, agendas, sign-ins sheets, flyers, minutes, notes for any training/meeting/site visit involving Flock and the City of Elk Grove.


Most emails can be found by searching for the @flocksafety.com domain. At minimum and to speed things up, please first search and produce the records of these custodians, and provide the rest on a rolling basis;
- Chief of Police - Robert Davis
- The Real Time Information Manager - Andrea Cortez
- City Manager - Jason Berhmann
- Mayor - Bobby Singh-Allen
- Vice Mayor - Darren Suen
- Councilmember - Rod Brewer
- Councilmember - Kevin Spease
- Councilmember - Sergio Robles
- Sacramento Country Sheriff - Jim Cooper
- Sacramento District Attorney - Thien Ho
- Elk Grove City Attorney- Jonathan Hobbs
- Elk Grove City Manager - Jason Berhmann


For anything withheld, please specify the record and the specific exemption.

Definitions:
- "Flock" refers to Flock Group Inc or Flock Safety, it's employees, contractors, installers, resellers, and public affairs consultants, or anyone acting on their behalf.
- "Communication" refers to emails (attachments, forwards, messages where either party appears in the To, From, CC, or BCC field), texts and messaging apps communication, Microsoft Teams chats, Calendar invitations, on any devices or accounts used for City Business.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Yevgeniy Beregovyy
